hec.model

Class PairedValues

  • java.lang.Object
    • hec.model.PairedValues
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    AsciiSerializable, FieldAccessor, java.io.Serializable, java.lang.Cloneable

    public class PairedValues
extends java.lang.Object
implements AsciiSerializable, java.lang.Cloneable
    Represents an array of paired values. Parsing functions are provided to read from and write data to strings. Functions are provided to interpolate data between intervals.
    Author:
    John F. DeGeorge, RMA
    See Also:
    Serialized Form
